Results.ReviewText: It’s a great little grill. I think a adapter hose to connect a 20lb propane tank should be included though. You can run through the small 1lb tanks quickly. Other than that, it’s been a terrific grill to cook on.
Results.Title: Weber q1200

Results.ReviewText: I wanted a small grill for our RV and after talking to a number of people and doing a lot of research, I decided on this grill.  I was concerned about it's small size and horseshoe flame tube because most grills with this configuration and not having flame guards, generally do not have consistent heat from edge to edge.  Boy was I pleasantly surprised!  This unit heats fast and has very even heating from edge to edge.  So grilling a large steak or a pork tenderloin produced an even char with no burn spots or uneven cooking.  If I have anything negative to say is that due to it's small cover, it loses heat quickly when you open it.  Can't get around that, but it gets back up to temperature quickly.  I suggest you get the 20 lb tank adapter as the 1 lb canisters just don't last long.  I bought an 11lb tank and it will last for weeks.   Overall, very happy with the unit.
Results.Title: Suprisingly good!

Results.ReviewText: Light weight,portable,easy to use .cleans up easily.

Results.ReviewText: PERFECT in every way for all my grilling needs and more! Couldn’t be easier to put together, and portability is just amazing. I live on a second floor and store my grill in the garage. So easy to roll it out, use it, cleans up great, then roll it back inside! PERFECT and highly recommend this. The Built app was a huge help with assembly. This weekend I’ll be taking it to the park to chill eat & relax! No problem, Enjoy ((:

Results.ReviewText: This grill cooks evenly with no flare ups. Easy to move and set up. We use it for camping so we like the light weight.

Results.ReviewText: Very good grill for putting in the back of our suv to take back in the mountains on a Creekside with our grandkids or put it in the under bay of our motor home. Results.ReviewText: Certainly very disappointed.  I wasn't ever able to get this thing to 500 degrees F ! warm sunny day, weather not an issue.  It just DID NOT perform even close to what is described as possible nor did it work adequately enough to replace an actual BBQ.  Sad really.  I read the preheat directions.. seemed reasonable enough. Did it exactly.  and temps peaked out about 400-450 at best.  Wasted an entire propane tank just trying to get the temp to an adequate level. Cook times were WAY off from what is described in manual lol. unbelievable. an ok bbq but NOT worth $200+! Come on guys really?!  If I could return this thing?  I would. Wanted to like it.. but did not live up to reasonable expectations.
Results.Title: Mediocre bbq AT BEST. Not worth the high price tag

Results.ReviewText: Compact size; great for 2 people or small family. Heats up quickly. Love the blue color! Replacement for a worn out Weber Q2000 so we are repeat customers!  Very pleased with our purchase

Results.ReviewText: This little gas grill is a great grill if you are only cooking for two or cooking side dishes while using a different cooking method for the main course. I have always insisted on using charcoal, however I have used this more in the last month than my Ceramic charcoal grill. The one thing I have always hated about gas grills is the flare ups get out of control. This little grill seam to work great with very little flare ups as long as you maintain and clean it to avoid grease build-ups.
